text_block_list.name: Yori
text_block_list.text:
By the way, this isn't the first time you've visited this tower, is it?
Who did you come with last time?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ところでさ。
アンタ
この塔に来るの、
初めてじゃないのよね？
前は誰と来たの？

text_block_list.name: Yori
text_block_list.text:
A couple of Caon members and that girl from Twinkle Wish...?
H-huh... I see...
text_block_list.orig_text:
【自警団（カォン）】の二人と、
【トゥインクルウィッシュ】の……？
へ、
へぇ。
そうなんだ。

text_block_list.name: Yori
text_block_list.text: You really do seem to know a lot of girls, don't you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アンタって、
本当に女の子の知り合いが多いわよね。

text_block_list.name: Yori
text_block_list.text:
N-not that I'm saying that's a bad thing or anything!
I'm not saying that, but... I-it's just... Urghh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
べ、
別に
それが悪いって言いたいわけじゃないわよ？
言いたいわけじゃないけど……
そ、
その。
うぅ～

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text: I wish you'd picked us for your first time instead!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アカリ、
お兄ちゃんの初めてがよかったなぁ～

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
You think so too, don't you, sis?
We'd have been ready and willing if he'd only said the word, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃんもそう思ったんだよね？
私たちに先に声を掛けてくれればよかったのに！　
って。

text_block_list.name: Yori
text_block_list.text:
Well, yes... Wait, wha—?! H-heck no!
Of course I wasn't thinking anything like that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうね……
って、
えっ！？　
ち、
違う！！
別に
私はそんな風に思ってなんかないわよ！！

text_block_list.name: Yori
text_block_list.text:
Wh-why should it matter to me who you climb towers with?!
That's obviously your own business, not mine!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
アンタが誰とどこに行こうが
アンタの勝手だし！
私が
とやかく言う権利なんて無いわけだから！！

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
Really~? Sure, it's his own decision,
but that's no reason not to tell him how we feel, is it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇ～？　
権利は無いかもしれないけど、
気持ちを伝えるのは
自由なんじゃないかなぁ？

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
Awww... She was so close!
Still, she's definitely making progress!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう～、
今の惜しかったな～！
でも、
さっきよりも前進してるよね！

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text: If she can keep it up... I can't wait to see what happens next!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この調子でいけば……
アカリ、
期待しちゃうな～♪

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text: Let's keep on doing our very best today! Right, sis?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これからも
諦めないで頑張ろうね、
お姉ちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Yori
text_block_list.text:
Huh? R-right. Of course...
...Wait, what're you even talking about?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
う、
うん。
そうね……
って、
一体何の話？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: As Akari looked on happily, Yori didn't know what to think.
text_block_list.orig_text:
盛り上がるアカリに、
置いてけぼりにされるヨリだった。
